name: CIDR Calculator
summary: Calculate network, broadcast, host range, and mask from a CIDR block.
description: Enter an IPv4 CIDR like 192.168.1.0/24 to see network address, broadcast, first and last host, subnet mask, and usable host count.

faqs.question: What format should I use?
faqs.answer: IPv4 address followed by slash and prefix length, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8.

faqs.question: IPv6 support?
faqs.answer: This tool focuses on IPv4 CIDR blocks.
